feature: Title type set like Apple sets it: tracking, leading, New York and a gradient through the words
summary: Picked text now has Tracking and Leading boxes under Size and Weight, New York is on the Font menu and draws as New York, and the Color row can run a gradient through the words, which a title can slide across them over time with a Gradient position key.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open the sample recording.

try.do: Pick the Text tool, click the video, type Field notes and press Command-Return.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: With the title picked, type 96 into Size, -2.8 into Tracking and 106 into Leading, pressing Return after each.
Choose New York in the Font menu.
Click the Color row's well and press the Linear tile.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Close the picker and look at the words.

evaluate: Does -2.8 Tracking look like the tight headline spacing of an Apple title?
Are percents the right way to type tracking and leading, or would you rather type Photoshop's thousandths of an em and leading in points?
Does the ramp read as running through the letters, rather than as a coloured box behind them?
Does one Command-Z taking the gradient off (and leaving the font and spacing) match what you expected?
rough: No mock draws a Leading control, so it reads as a percent of the size like Tracking (106 for the Apple mock's 1.06). Tracking in percent matches the mock's own 'tracking -1.2%'.

Leading tighter than the face's own grows the text box by the overhang above and below, so the letters are never cut; a title placed from the mock's CSS top edge sits that many points higher. Folded into title-pages-that-look-like-apple-designed-them, which lays the designs out.

Gradient position is keyable on words wearing a gradient (the Properties picker's Text group), but nothing in the panel sets how long the ramp is: a key on it first makes the ramp twice the words' length. The Gradient Word design (220%) is built by the title-pages task, which can set the length directly.
A saved colour style that is a gradient now lands as a gradient on text in either release, because text can draw one. The picker's gradient tiles on a text row are offered in Next only.
Tracking cannot be keyed yet, so the mock's Track In build (letters closing up over time) is not buildable from this alone. Folded into title-pages-that-look-like-apple-designed-them.
Typing into the canvas with tight leading uses the Mac's own text layout, which shares the squeeze differently from the drawn title; the draft may sit a point or two off until Return.
